name: Cousins
overview: The Bible presents instances where close kinship marriages occurred, such as Amram marrying his father's sister (Exodus 6:20) and Esau taking Mahalath, his cousin, as a wife (Genesis 28:9). These examples demonstrate that marriage between relatives was practiced among God's people, though Leviticus 18:6 cautions against approaching close kin in ways that violate His commands. God's blessing to multiply and fill the earth (Genesis 1:28) sets the foundation for family relationships, while Genesis 20:12 illustrates the complexity of kinship ties within marriage. Overall, Scripture acknowledges marriages among relatives within certain boundaries established by the Lord.
